name: CLAIM_FREEZE
description: Requires explicit formal specification of candidate claims, circuit grammar, error metrics, refutation criteria, and immutable cryptographic protocol digest in SEP package.
disposition_note: Passed: SEP-QF-2026-001 frozen with 5 independent claims, 4-level attack ladder protocol, and coverage estimator requirements.

name: CLASSICAL_BOUNDARY
description: Requires execution of the 4-level classical attack ladder (exact, MPS, Pauli-path, heuristic) with comprehensive resource measurements before QPU execution can be evaluated.
disposition_note: Not Ready: Level 0 exact baseline simulated; Levels 1-3 classical attacks and full resource ledger pending execution.

name: QPU_ELIGIBILITY

disposition_note: Blocked: GATE-002 is NOT_READY, S_deployed is FALSE (REAL-CAMPAIGN-20260926T160434Z), and BlueQubit external QPU allocation is prospective.

name: ADJUDICATION
description: Requires raw bitstrings, independent execution reproduction, coverage-adjusted entropy validation, and adverse-first evaluation to produce definitive claim disposition.
disposition_note: Not Ready: Experimental data collection and independent reproduction pending.

name: PUBLIC_RELEASE
